stories.story: A cold rabbit was on a high ledge. Lily said, “I want to rescue the rabbit.” Dad said, “The ladder is in the shed.” Lily used the ladder to lift the rabbit down. Lily wrapped the rabbit in the warm blanket. The rabbit rested in the warm blanket.
